dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Huh? So you're looking after the drinks stand now... If I'd known sooner, I would have stopped by this morning!

choices.text: Thanks for your support!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I've got to say, I'm getting curious. I've heard a lot about your mixology skills.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I wonder what kinds of drinks you can mix with the ingredients Glenfidia has prepared?

choices.text: You seem busy...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I don't have much of a choice... It's just one thing after another right now. First off, the Knights of Favonius' annual combat assessment is coming up, and this year, the standards are higher than ever.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: As the Captain of the Reconnaissance Company, I have to lead by example. At the very least, I need to rank as one of the top three captains in the practical portion...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: So, I've been intensifying my training lately.

choices.text: So that's your style, huh?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmph, being a descendant of sinners means I have to work hard to maintain my position. I'll have you know, I've never once neglected my duties...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Anyway, on top of all that, the General Affairs Company has invited a renowned Champion Duelist from the Court of Fontaine to come here for a "swordsmanship exchange."

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Since I'm one of the captains with the highest attendance rate when it comes to these things — and I'm fairly skilled with a claymore — I was chosen as our representative.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I have to prepare thoroughly to make sure I'm a serious match for the Champion Duelist, and then after the exchange, I need to write at least six different reports based on the results...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Anyway, on top of all that, my duel with Miss Clorinde required a lot of focus and energy.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Learning how to turn defense into attack and seize the initiative when facing a combined assault from sword and musket... Even now, I'm still chewing through the details...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But in the end, the exchange went well, and both parties learned a great deal. Never mind writing reports from six different perspectives — I feel like there's enough worth mentioning to write twenty-four of the things!

choices.text: Sounds like you could do with a very stiff drink...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Oh, I sure could! Anything that'll perk me up would be welcome. I'll leave the details to you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Given Eula's current condition, it might be a good idea to mix her a "Twinkling Starlight.")

choices.text: Sounds like you could do with something to replenish your energy...
It's my first time seeing this side of you as a captain...
You've been working extra hard lately, haven't you?
Anytime you need a drink, I'm here to serve!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your all-new "Seafoam Swordsong," mixed to meet your personal preferences!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh my, what beautiful colors! And you even added my Romaritime Flower Fruit Extract!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: The aroma is perfect, and I can smell the alcohol, but it doesn't stifle the fruity fragrance... Let's see how it tastes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't wait to hear what you think!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Phew, give me a moment to... *hic*... come up with the right words. I need to think carefully...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I know it's unbecoming of a lady, and a proper connoisseur would savor their drinks slowly...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But... I'm sorry, this is just... too good to be true!

choices.text: Of course! Feel free to order as many as you like!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And so Eula, lost in friendly conversation, drank three Seafoam Swordsongs without even realizing it...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ah... Ahahaha... Oh no, w—what was I going to say... I've completely lost my train of thought, haha...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ah, whatever, I feel fantastic! This cocktail... It's the best I've ever had!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ah... I... I think I'm gonna head home and get some sleep...

choices.text: Do you think you've maybe had one too many...?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ha... Don't worry about me! This is... the happiest tipsy I've been in years. I'm still far from being drunk!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: By the time I've gone a few rounds with that... Miss Clorinde... and completed my reports... I—I'll have been on duty for three months straight!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: By the time I've written up those reports from my exchange with Miss Clorinde... I'll have been on duty for three months straight!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Jean... the Acting Grand Master... Isn't it about time she gave me some time off!?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I won't be forgetting this injustice in a hurry... You mark my words!

choices.text: Maybe I should have gone easier with the Fire-Water...
How many do you want? Two? Three? It's no problem for me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One Twinkling Starlight for Captain Eula. Hope you like it!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Judging by your confident tone, I'm certain I will. Well then, I'll make sure to savor this thoroughly...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Sweet and tingly, with a delightful airiness. The fizzy water really brings it to life...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I suddenly feel full of vim and vigor, but just one glass doesn't quite scratch the itch... How about something with a bit more bite?

choices.text: Not strong enough for you?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hah, don't hold back. You don't need to worry about putting me on the floor with nothing but a couple of drinks!

choices.text: Hmm... Let's chat while I decide!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Works for me! The 1st Company hasn't assigned me any paperwork for tonight, so I'm free to catch up and try your new creations at my leisure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's been a while since we last saw each other. Have you been stationed near Dragonspine this whole time?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Yes, I have. For a while, the situation there was... difficult. A gang of outlaw engineers was messing about with some sort of mechanism-control technology, attempting to manipulate Ruin Graders so they could rob merchant caravans...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: To make matters worse, several veteran knights who had been stationed at Dornman Port were transferred to my squad, and they weren't happy to be taking orders from "that Lawrence girl"...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Leading them on this mission was quite eventful. It took three weeks of stealth operations in the snow — with no fires to keep us warm — before we finally located the enemy's stronghold.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Those veteran knights faced the bitter cold and were almost taken down by the enemy's smuggled battle meks... Fortunately, the battle went our way, and they had no choice but to acknowledge my abilities.

choices.text: I'm sorry you had to deal with that...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Me? I'm completely fine... But thank you for your concern!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: It was mentally tiring for sure, but fortunately, the operation wore them down far more than it did me. They won't be questioning my authority again anytime soon.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If any new recruits try to make my life difficult, I'll just have my veterans give them a few friendly pointers. I guess you could call them a permanent solution, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm just wondering, that bottle you're carrying... is it imported fruit juice?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That's right. The merchant I got it from called it "Romaritime Flower Fruit Extract." It has a very unique smell. Here, have a bottle!

choices.text: Have you been drinking a lot of this lately?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Oh... It's a necessary courtesy.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: In that book Miss Megistus lent me — "The Blade Dancer: Twenty Years On" — it says...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: "After a duel, a Fontainian swordsman will politely invite their defeated opponents to a banquet."

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: To properly play host to Miss Clorinde, I searched for quite some time to locate a rare goods merchant in Dornman Port who sold this juice.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds like something out of a story...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmm... I had my doubts at first, too.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But Amber said something that makes a lot of sense. She said that even if this custom doesn't really exist, following it still shows I've made an effort to understand Fontaine's cultural heritage.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Besides, who doesn't like trying new things, right?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I'll treat Miss Clorinde to this juice at our post-training banquet!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: When I gave it to her at our post-training banquet, Miss Clorinde really did enjoy this juice!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How are you feeling about your upcoming contest?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Oh my... To be honest, I'm eager to begin, but also a little nervous.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How do you feel after your contest?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Oh my... To be honest, before we crossed swords, I was feeling eager, but also a little nervous.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Miss Clorinde's combat style comes from the mysterious "Marechaussee Hunters"... In the library, there are some old Fontainian newspapers from hundreds of years ago that give some idea of how formidable an organization it was.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: A more recent newspaper claimed that Miss Clorinde was an orphan from an underwater kingdom, and that before battle she would perform rituals inviting spirits to possess her sword...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Assuming these rumors are true... or that Miss Clorinde's abilities might even be more extraordinary than that, it's important that I'm prepared for anything.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Certainly, from my own experiences, Miss Clorinde's abilities more than match those descriptions.

choices.text: Such a historic showdown deserves an extra special cocktail...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Incorporating elements of swordsmanship into a drink? Huh. Certainly a creative idea, I'll give you that...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I sure could do with an energy boost, but... how do you plan to express something like swordsmanship with a cocktail?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: A commemorative cocktail at a time like this sounds nice, but... how do you plan to express something like swordsmanship with a drink?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: From what I've seen... Fontainian fighters armed with rapiers excel at thrusting attacks. They put a high price on... precision and sustained pressure.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmm... That definitely matches the description I read in that book.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If I were to compare them to a drink, I'd say they're like coffee, Bulle Fruit Icewine... or Mondstadt Fruit Wine. They may not overwhelm your senses, but they refuse to fade away.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In fact, the first drink you tried had a fruit wine base.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That's right... You really know your stuff. I doubt there's anyone else in all of Teyvat who could come up with such a perfect metaphor!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your swordsmanship is different, though. You're like a lead dancer with the claymore, guiding your blade through big, sweeping arcs...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You only need one hit to unleash an avalanche of destruction...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In other words, your style emphasizes... forceful impact at the moment of contact?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: T—There's no need to make it sound so fancy! It's just an aristocratic variant of Favonius Bladework, with a bit of personal flair...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're more like... a strong spirit that hits the senses hard, and then leaves a clean, icy aftertaste without lingering flavors.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Fire-Water!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: In recent years, Fire-Water's gained popularity the world over, following in the wake of prosperous Snezhnayan merchants. These days, almost every tavern has a signature drink that uses it as a base...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then we've found the perfect solution together!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You really are good! Why don't we try replacing the fruit wine with Fire-Water?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: As for the alcohol content... that's not a problem! Plenty of the expedition team may have drunk themselves senseless with Fire-Water... But me? I'm... I'm full of confidence!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you usually eat when you're busy?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If you want to know what I've been eating recently, I'd better start by mentioning the Logistics Company's latest revolution...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: They launched a "Diet Improvement Initiative" and started distributing a form of standardized canned food to knights operating in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: In the past, we only had dry rations. Every mealtime, we had to set up pots and campfires, roll dice to choose a cook, and take turns standing guard... In all honesty, it was a bit of a hassle.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Now we just need to bring our "Standard Field Rations" comprising of five cans and nine paper packages. We can heat the cans by the campfire, and then we're ready to eat.

choices.text: Sounds pretty convenient...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Haha, you did say "sounds like," right? Our canned food supplier has quite the stellar reputation, and their regular meals are indeed quite good...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The problem is... in order to meet preservation standards, they have to make their military-grade meals way too salty!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The vice-captain of the Fifth Company, who has a somewhat dry sense of humor, went so far as to say, "This food's bad enough to bring down the wrath of Liyue's Stove God."

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: In any case, after eating it for a week, my taste buds have gone completely numb.

choices.text: Is it really that bad...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You can hardly blame the Logistics Company. After all, it is hard to please everyone. Our feedback has already been submitted, and they should be working on fixing the issue.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Of course, having fresh meals prepared in camp by a dedicated company chef is still the best option.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I think that's all I need. I know exactly how to prepare your next cocktail!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Brilliant, I'm looking forward to seeing how you do!

choices.text: Someone should be held to account...
Sounds like there isn't a downside...
Should we commemorate it with a sword-themed drink?
Why carry it around?
Did you catch a cold?
Just making it stronger won't cut it. I need to rewrite the recipe from scratch!
Looking for something with more of a kick?
